overview: OcuScreen+ is a research-oriented eye health screening prototype that analyzes eye images to detect early visual indicators of jaundice, anemia, and corneal arcus. It examines the sclera, conjunctiva, and cornea for color patterns, brightness, and contrast — providing numeric risk scores, explainable reasoning, and an optional plain-language AI summary. Supports both anonymous one-time screenings and user accounts with saved history. Export results as PDF or JSON.
features: White patch calibration for cross-lighting accuracy
Sclera, conjunctiva & cornea analysis with numeric scores
Explainable reasoning for jaundice, anemia, and corneal arcus risk
PDF and JSON export of full screening reports
User accounts with full screening history
